jobs.title: Landscape Construction Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Working for Oxbow Pool and Landscape Contractors (Oxbow PLC) is an opportunity to join a dynamic team dedicated to excellence in the landscaping industry. With a strong reputation for quality and innovation, Oxbow PLC offers a supportive and inclusive work environment where employees are empowered to grow both personally and professionally. Our commitment to fostering a positive workplace culture, coupled with our focus on delivering exceptional service to our clients, makes Oxbow PLC an exciting and rewarding place to build a career. If you are passionate about landscaping and seeking a fulfilling role where your contributions are valued, consider joining us at Oxbow PLC.

Oxbow Pool and Landscape Contractors is seeking a Project Coordinator with experience in landscape construction, pool construction, general construction, or a closely related field.

This is a construction project support position—not an IT, software, or technology project coordinator role.

The Project Coordinator supports our Project Management and Pre-Construction teams in delivering high-end residential landscape and pool construction projects throughout the Bay Area. This position assists with project documentation, proposals, contracts, permits, submittals, RFIs, change orders, procurement, scheduling, billing documentation, and project closeout.

Monitor project schedules, deadlines, and critical milestones.
Coordinate the distribution of plans, specifications, contracts, and other project documents.
Support project billing, invoicing documentation, and administrative reporting.
Assist in maintaining document-control procedures and accurate project records.
Occasionally visit active construction sites to assist with project coordination.
Maintain the confidentiality of company, employee, client, and project information.
Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

Experience with construction software such as Procore, Bluebeam, Autodesk Forma, or AutoCAD is preferred.

Philadelphia Energy Authority and Residential Programs

Philadelphia Energy Authority (PEA) is an independent municipal authority advancing projects and programs that deliver on the City of Philadelphia’s most urgent priorities—lower bills, stronger infrastructure, safer neighborhoods, and quality jobs. Since 2016, PEA has supported over $1.3 billion in investment, creating more than 10,000 jobs in Philadelphia and driving $2.4 billion in economic benefits across Pennsylvania. By bundling critical repairs with energy upgrades into one streamlined process, the program is a one-stop solution that removes barriers that often prevent households from accessing support. Philadelphia Energy Authority and Residential Programs

Philadelphia Energy Authority (PEA) is an independent municipal authority advancing projects and programs that deliver on the City of Philadelphia’s most urgent priorities—lower bills, stronger infrastructure, safer neighborhoods, and quality jobs. Since 2016, PEA has supported over $1.3 billion in investment, creating more than 10,000 jobs in Philadelphia and driving $2.4 billion in economic benefits across Pennsylvania. Built to Last is a first-of-its-kind program helping low-income Philadelphia homeowners keep money in their pockets and their biggest investment in their possession. By bundling critical repairs with energy upgrades into one streamlined process, the program is a one-stop solution that removes barriers that often prevent households from accessing support.
